workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: Office Personnel 8 ½ hours including 30 minute lunch. non-professional staff should clock out and back in when taking their 30 minute lunch break.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Teacher and paraprofessional duty time will be determined by the building principal. A duty roster will be given to each teacher and one will be posted in the office. Special duty is a vital part of every teacher’s and paraprofessional’s responsibility.
